Revision 2's same-image pod template resulted in a different pod-template hash, so the scheduler created `app-545558c7f6` — the Deployment's own spec added the scheduling wall.

Patched the Deployment's pod template CPU request back to its original, unrequested value (`null` / omitted):

```
kubectl -n default patch deploy app --type=json \

```
